_comment: Copy this file to data-sources.json. The URLs below are the current
Deportation Data Project release from their public GitHub repositories:
ice:       arrests, detention-stints, detention-stays, joined arrests+stays
ice-detention-facilities: the facilities lookup used for facility names
URLs must be HTTPS and must point directly at the Parquet file, not at a
web page describing it. Downloads replace the local file only after they
are confirmed to be readable Parquet with the expected columns.
detention-stays-latest.parquet is optional; the core lookup does not read it.
